title.zh: 授权菲律宾加入拟设立的国际金融公司并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing Philippine Membership in the Proposed International Finance Corporation and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Authorizing Philippine Membership in the Proposed International Finance Corporation and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1604_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The President of the Philippines or his representative is hereby authorized to sign, on behalf of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines, the Article of Agreement of the International Finance Corporation.

There is hereby authorized to be appropriated the sum of three hundred thirty-two thousand P332,000.00 pesos to pay for the subscription of the Government of the Republic of the Philippines to the capital stock of the proposed International Finance Corporation.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 23, 1956.
[Articles of Agreement of the International Finance Corporation and Explanatory Memorandum were omitted due to lack of space]
